Contact.description: A person the firm deals with: fee earner, staff, client, opponent or witness. A first name alone is not an identity.

Matter.description: A legal matter the firm has open, known by its matter name.

Party.description:
Who appears in a matter and on which side: the firm's client, the opposing party, or a witness.
A fee earner working on a matter is not a party to it.

Reporting.description: A standing line in the firm: whose supervising partner or whose secretary someone is.

CaseTask.description: A piece of work on a matter. requested_by asked for it, assigned_to does it, reviewed_by checks it. A suggestion is not a task.

Disbursement.description: A cost paid out on a matter. approved stays empty until a sign-off is recorded.

questions.q: Who is the client on the Arden Mill lease?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Matter)-[:client]->(n1:Contact) WHERE n0.name = 'Arden Mill lease' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the opposing party on the Ferncliff probate?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Matter)-[:opponent]->(n1:Contact) WHERE n0.name = 'Ferncliff probate' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is a witness in the Ostrava shipping claim?

questions.speaker: clemency

questions.q: Who is Farida Saliba's supervising partner?

questions.q: Has the counsel fee been approved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Disbursement) WHERE n0.item = 'counsel fee' RETURN n0.approved AS approved

questions.q: Is there a record of the survey fee being approved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Disbursement) WHERE n0.item = 'survey fee' RETURN coalesce(n0.approved, false) AS approved

questions.q: How much was the court fee?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Disbursement) WHERE n0.item = 'court fee' RETURN n0.amount_pounds AS amount_pounds

questions.q: Which tasks did Yaw Danquah review?

questions.q: What actions and hours are logged on the Ostrava shipping claim?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Matter)<-[:matter]-(n1:CaseTask) WHERE n0.name = 'Ostrava shipping claim' RETURN n1.action AS action, n1.hours AS hours

questions.q: Who paid costs on the Arden Mill lease?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Matter)<-[:matter]-(n1:Disbursement)-[:paid_by]->(n2:Contact) WHERE n0.name = 'Arden Mill lease' RETURN n2.name AS name
MATCH (n0:CaseTask) WHERE n0.action = 'lease review' RETURN n0.urgent AS urgent

questions.q: Is there a record of the witness statement being urgent?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CaseTask) WHERE n0.action = 'witness statement' RETURN coalesce(n0.urgent, false) AS urgent

questions.q: Which tasks concern the defence, and what is their status?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CaseTask) WHERE n0.action CONTAINS 'defence' RETURN n0.action AS action, n0.status AS status
